newsitem.title: BRAZIL: One killed as six attempt jailbreak in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: One killed as six attempt jailbreak in Brazil.

text.p: One prison officer was killed and six injured when inmates tried to escape on Wednesday from the Casa de Detencao jail in Sao Paulo, private television news said.

Six prisoners took a guard hostage and tried to escape by driving a garbage truck through the prison gates, Globo news said. They were stopped by military police as they rammed through the gate, but in the escape attempt one security guard was run over and killed and six others were injured.
A spokesman at the Casa de Detencao, which holds around 6,000 inmates, said he was unable to confirm exactly what happened because the situation was still confused and tense.
